title: Replication lag on read replica
symptoms: Stale data reported by read-only API endpoints
ReplicaIOPS or ReplicaLag CloudWatch/RDS metric elevated
root_cause: Heavy write load on primary; missing indexes causing large WAL; replica undersized; network latency; DDL lock on primary
workaround: Route critical reads to primary temporarily; identify and terminate long-running transactions; scale up replica instance class
permanent_fix: Right-size replica to match primary write throughput; optimize slow writes; use logical replication for specific tables if needed; set max_standby_streaming_delay appropriately

auto_healing.mechanism: Auto-failover read traffic to primary via DNS/connection string when lag exceeds threshold; auto-scale replica IOPS

notes: Define lag SLA per application tier (critical vs analytics)
